words.note: 直接表示某事容易理解、不模糊。
words.example: The clearness of the instructions made the task easy to complete.
words.exampleZh: 指示十分清楚，使任務容易完成。

exercises.original: The clarity of the instructions helped everyone finish the task correctly.
exercises.zh: 指示十分清楚，幫助所有人正確完成任務。
exercises.upgrade: The clearness of the instructions helped everyone finish the task correctly.

options.explanation: 也可能有幫助，因為指示若精確會減少錯誤；但句中首先強調 everyone could understand what to do。
instructions easy to understand，是 clearness 的直接語境。
通常指制度／程序的公開與易理解，不自然修飾普通 task instructions。
流暢度不是是否清楚的核心。
和 clarity 相反方向。
主要用於影像／聲音。

exercises.original: The teacher improved the clarity of the explanation by using a simple example.
exercises.upgrade: The teacher improved the clearness of the explanation by using a simple example.

options.explanation: simple example 直接提高理解程度。
例子可能更精確，但句中重點是 easier to understand。
不適合普通課堂 explanation。
例子正確不等於更容易理解。
是語流自然度，不是 explanation clarity。
不適用於抽象講解。

exercises.original: The report lacks clarity in several sections, so readers may misunderstand the conclusions.
exercises.upgrade: The report lacks clearness in several sections, so readers may misunderstand the conclusions.

options.explanation: readers may misunderstand 是最直接線索。
措辭不精確也可能造成誤解，但原句重整體可理解性。
和閱讀理解無關。
不是文章品質。
除非是政策程序公開程度，否則不自然。
不適用於報告意思是否清楚。

words.note: 表示思想、寫作或解釋清楚、易懂，而且結構有條理。
words.example: Her essay was praised for its lucidity.
words.exampleZh: 她的文章因思路清晰而受到讚賞。

exercises.original: The lecturer explained a difficult theory with remarkable clarity.
exercises.zh: 講者把一個困難理論解釋得非常明晰有條理。
exercises.upgrade: The lecturer explained a difficult theory with remarkable lucidity.

options.explanation: 理論可以解釋得正確，但仍可能很難懂。
difficult theory + explained clearly 是 lucidity 的典型 intellectual context。
更常用於 processes / institutions。
講得順不一定講得明白。
不適用於理論解釋。
理論本身未必簡單；只是解釋很清楚。

exercises.original: Her writing is admired for its clarity and logical structure.
exercises.upgrade: Her writing is admired for its lucidity and logical structure.

options.explanation: writing + logical structure 是 lucidity 的標誌性搭配。
可以正確但不一定清晰有條理。
簡短不是同義。
寫作流暢和論述明晰相關，但仍不是同一概念。
不自然描述一般寫作風格。
若說 sharpness of argument 可有別義，但不是此處 clarity。

exercises.original: Even under pressure, he answered the questions with impressive clarity of thought.
exercises.upgrade: Even under pressure, he answered the questions with impressive lucidity of thought.

options.explanation: 答案可能精確，但 of thought 更自然搭配 lucidity。
lucidity of thought 是非常典型的固定搭配。
只說答得流暢，不保證思路清楚。
不適用於個人思維品質。
可指思維敏銳，但更像 intellectual quickness，不等於 clarity。
自信不代表清楚。

words.note: 表示語言、數據、定義或操作沒有含糊，細節準確。
words.example: The instructions must be written with precision.
words.exampleZh: 指示必須寫得準確無誤。

exercises.original: The legal document requires clarity in the wording so that no sentence can be interpreted in two ways.
exercises.zh: 法律文件的措辭必須精確，避免一句話有兩種解讀。
exercises.upgrade: The legal document requires precision in the wording so that no sentence can be interpreted in two ways.

options.explanation: 簡單措辭可能有幫助，但「不能有兩種解讀」重 exactness。
legal wording + avoid ambiguity 是 precision 的核心。
法律文本不以流暢性為首要目標。
法律制度可有 transparency，但 wording 本身更精確是 precision。
不適合法律措辭。
文筆優美不是此處要求。

exercises.original: The scientist described the measurement process with great clarity, giving exact values and units.
exercises.upgrade: The scientist described the measurement process with great precision, giving exact values and units.

options.explanation: exact values and units 是最直接線索。
可能也講得清楚，但這裡重 numerical exactness。
不是組織程序公開問題。
和數值準確無關。
不一定簡單。
不合技術描述。

exercises.original: The editor asked for greater clarity in the definition because one word was too broad.
exercises.upgrade: The editor asked for greater precision in the definition because one word was too broad.

options.explanation: one word was too broad 表示需要更準確、更窄的 wording。
不是語流問題。
不適合 definition wording。
不是制度公開性。
不是文字品質。
變短不一定變準確。

words.note: 表示語言、聲音、文字或解釋是否能被理解。
words.example: The speaker's pronunciation affected the intelligibility of the presentation.
words.exampleZh: 講者的發音影響了演講的可理解程度。

exercises.original: The clarity of the announcement was poor because the speaker was too far from the microphone.
exercises.zh: 由於講者離咪高峰太遠，廣播的可理解程度很差。
exercises.upgrade: The intelligibility of the announcement was poor because the speaker was too far from the microphone.

options.explanation: 聲音可以有 sharpness，但句中結果是聽不清內容。
microphone distance affecting whether listeners understand speech，是 intelligibility 的典型語境。
不是用詞準確問題。
不適合音訊。
內容可以準確但仍聽不清。
講者可能很流暢，只是收音差。

exercises.original: The teacher slowed down to improve the clarity of her speech for beginner learners.
exercises.upgrade: The teacher slowed down to improve the intelligibility of her speech for beginner learners.

options.explanation: slowing down helps listeners understand spoken language more easily。
語法或內容正確不一定因放慢而改變。
不適用於 speech comprehension。
不是音質細節的主要問題。
放慢語速不一定提高自信。
和理解度無關。

exercises.original: Background noise reduced the clarity of the recording, especially for listeners unfamiliar with the accent.
exercises.upgrade: Background noise reduced the intelligibility of the recording, especially for listeners unfamiliar with the accent.

options.explanation: 不是錄音內容措辭是否精確。
noise + unfamiliar accent 直接影響聽懂程度。
不適用。
音質可能變差，但句中特別指出 listeners understand less。
說話者本身的流暢度沒有改變。
內容可以完全準確卻因噪音聽不懂。

words.note: 比喻上表示程序、政策、決策或資訊開放、容易理解。
words.example: The organization promised greater transparency in its decision-making.
words.exampleZh: 該機構承諾提高決策過程的透明度。

exercises.original: The public asked for greater clarity about how the funding decisions were made.
exercises.zh: 公眾要求更清楚了解資金分配決定是如何作出的。
exercises.upgrade: The public asked for greater transparency about how the funding decisions were made.

options.explanation: 可以要求數字精確，但句中重點是 decision process 是否公開、可理解。
how the funding decisions were made 是 governance transparency 的典型語境。
不適用。
不涉及語言流暢。
簡短不等於公開清楚。
資訊正確和過程透明是不同概念。

exercises.original: The company promised more clarity in its pricing policy after customers complained about hidden fees.
exercises.upgrade: The company promised more transparency in its pricing policy after customers complained about hidden fees.

options.explanation: hidden fees directly point to lack of openness in pricing。
價格可以精確列出，但問題是是否公開所有費用。
政策文字可以明晰，但 hidden fees 是 disclosure issue。
不適用。
不適用。
政策可以很簡單但仍隱藏費用。

exercises.original: The new rules are intended to improve clarity in the hiring process by making selection criteria public.
exercises.upgrade: The new rules are intended to improve transparency in the hiring process by making selection criteria public.

options.explanation: criteria 可以準確，但關鍵線索是 making ... public。
公開選拔標準正是提高 process transparency。
若標準太模糊，precision 也重要；但 public disclosure 才是 decisive clue。
不適用。
不適用。
與公開程度無關。

words.note: 表示影像、聲音或細節呈現得清楚、分明。
words.example: The new lens improves the sharpness of the image.
words.exampleZh: 新鏡頭提高了影像的清晰度。

exercises.original: The new camera produces images with much greater clarity.
exercises.zh: 新相機拍出的影像清晰度高得多。
exercises.upgrade: The new camera produces images with much greater sharpness.

options.explanation: 除非談透明材質，否則不表示相片細節清晰。
camera + images 是 image sharpness 的典型搭配。
可描述測量，但不自然表示影像細節。
用於思想／文字。
主要是語言、聲音是否可理解。
不適用於影像。

exercises.original: Adjusting the focus improved the clarity of the text on the screen.
exercises.upgrade: Adjusting the focus improved the sharpness of the text on the screen.

options.explanation: adjusting the focus 直接改善 visual sharpness。
不是文字內容措辭更精確。
不是透明度。
不是思想表達。
不是閱讀流暢性。
文字內容沒有改變。

exercises.original: The recording lost clarity when the audio was compressed too heavily.
exercises.upgrade: The recording lost sharpness when the audio was compressed too heavily.

options.explanation: 如果語音因此難以聽懂也可用，但句中只說 audio quality 在壓縮後變差。
heavy compression can reduce crispness/detail，最符合聲音品質語境。
不是數值或措辭精確度。
不適用。
只用於思想／表達。
錄音內容正確性沒有改變。

falseSynonyms.zh: 簡單 ≠ 清晰 一件事可以很簡單但表達不清，也可以很複雜但講解清晰。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Clarity is about being easy to understand; simplicity is about having little complexity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 準確 ≠ 清晰 accuracy 表示正確；clarity 表示容易理解。兩者可同時存在，也可分開。
很接近，但更重精確 precision 強調 exact wording / measurement；clarity 更重 understanding。
只在部分抽象語境接近 政策 transparent 不代表每一句文字本身都 clear。
只適合感官清晰度 image sharpness 很自然，但 argument sharpness 不等於 clarity。
流暢 ≠ 清晰 說話流暢不一定條理清楚。
- clear = 清楚的（形容詞） - clarity = 清晰、明確（名詞）
falseSynonyms.point: a clear explanation clarity of explanation

falseSynonyms.zh: - precise = 精確的 - precision = 精確度
